from collections import Counter

def _mode(xs):
    return Counter(xs).most_common(1)[0][0]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    interior = _mode(x for row in grid for x in row)
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if _mode(row) != interior]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if _mode(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)) != interior]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            v = grid[r0][c0]
            row.append(v if grid[r0][c1] == v == grid[r1][c0] == grid[r1][c1] else interior)
        out.append(row)
    marks = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(out) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != interior]
    if not marks: return [[interior]]
    a,b=min(r for r,c in marks),max(r for r,c in marks)
    x,y=min(c for r,c in marks),max(c for r,c in marks)
    return [row[x:y+1] for row in out[a:b+1]]
